title: Taiwanese American Association Atlanta 亞特蘭大 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association Atlanta (ATAA; 亞特蘭大 台灣同鄉會) is the Atlanta-area chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA; 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization of Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Atlanta, Georgia area.
